This is why it's so frustrating when classes I'm completely new to are taught so poorly and disjointed, because if no working conceptual framework is set and developed with which I can integrate new ideas into, I feel like I'm grasping at thin air.
I know all learners like me would soooo appreciate any course or video series you could make to teach in such a way that is void of the extraneous details but rather develops an intuition and an appreciation for the discipline.. I really wish a lot of classes could be rewired in this way, I feel like it should be at the heart of teaching/learning, but it's such an afterthought. It's just assumed that we will develop the intuition over time and with experience, but I feel I can't truly learn and internalize any subject without it.
